[WEBINAR]
Bouncing Back:
Consumer Views on Traveling Again Register today and be the first to see the results of our global survey of leisure travelers. As the travel industry looks to bounce back, one thing looms large: consumer willingness to travel again.
Flywire is preparing to release a new research report detailing the results of an independent survey of travelers across the globe. The interactive report looks at how leisure travelers have responded to the recent crisis and their future plans to travel again.
Join us for this live webinar <[[https://more.flywire.com/Bouncing-Back-Webinar-June-2020.html?utm_source=EM1]]> on Tuesday, June 16 @ 11AM EDT to be the first to see the results when the report is released. We'll review the key findings and discuss the results with a panel of travel professionals.
Panelists: Shannon Stowell - CEO, Adventure Travel Trade Association Gonçalo Correia - General Manager, Tours For You Jenny Jewczyk - Reservations & Sales, Nimmo Bay Wilderness Resort
<[[https://more.flywire.com/Bouncing-Back-Webinar-June-2020.html?utm_source=EM1]]>
